description: M02-U11 case index (m02-plan revision 5 §3, §4): every exit case and claim mapped to its Cargo test targets and tests, per platform. tests: {target: [name | prefix*] | "*"}; a name ending in '*' matches every test whose full name or last segment starts with the rest, and '*' alone is the whole target. Patterns are resolved into required-inventory.json from the build host's sources (m02-evidence.py --generate-inventory) and never from run logs. platform_only: {"<target>" | "<target>::<test prefix>": [platforms]} limits where a test exists (#[cfg] gating, read from the cross-built binaries' symbols with platform-tests.py). build_host_paths: tests that truly need the build host; remote harnesses skip them, a neutral one counts as run on the build host, any other is a harness gap that keeps the row in_progress. It is empty since ADR-0007 §12.32 item 3: every test that reads repository files (schemas, golden files, snapshots, documents, fixtures, the sources a static scan reads) resolves them through heimdall_testkit::repo::repo_root, which honours HM_REPO_ROOT, and the hook binary through HM_FIXTURE_HOOK; the native harnesses ship those files (lib.sh M02_REPO_DIRS) and set both, so these tests run on every platform. platform_only_rationale gives the reason for each platform_only entry of this file (ADR-0006 §13.13 item 5). child_entries: #[ignore]d child-process entry points, never required. scenario_targets: harness-defined steps (not Cargo tests) logged in the same format. observation_targets: the Cargo test targets whose tests print `observation` lines (ADR-0007 [I]/[U] facts: exchange and birth-time support, client and Git observations); every remote run uses --show-output, and run-macos.sh runs these once more through cargo with --show-output because check.sh discards passing output. blocked_rows: per case, the platform rows that need an owner input (m02-plan §7), always blocked with that input named.

platform_only_rationale.e2e_cli_m02::unix::: Pseudo-terminal cases (#[cfg(unix)]): the owner's typed confirmations (ADR-0006 §3.1) and the CLI prompts on a pty. Their --json and --non-interactive counterparts for uninstall, doctor, setup preview and status and the catalog are e2e_cli_m02::json::* and run on every platform; Windows interactive confirmation is the pseudoconsole drivers' row, which waits on B5 (ADR-0007 §12.32 item 4; ADR-0006 §13.13 item 5). a21_cli_inventory_wording_never_claims_completeness is here because its Match exec command is POSIX (/usr/bin/touch).
platform_only_rationale.e2e_cli_m02::ssh::: Ordinary ssh, Git, scp and sftp against the loopback fixture sshd with the owner's typed confirmations on a pty (#[cfg(unix)]); the Windows client rows are the native harness's and the B2/B4 owner-input rows (ADR-0007 §12.32 item 4).
platform_only_rationale.e2e_cli_m02::terminal::: The pty helpers' own regression (#[cfg(unix)]: rustix ptys); Windows has the pseudoconsole drivers (ADR-0007 §12.32 items 4, 6 and 10).
